credits.title: Credits & licences
credits.body: This app uses open-source software, Poppins fonts, Lucide icons and Material Symbols. Select an entry to read its bundled licence and attribution. The list also includes dependency build tools.
credits.images: The 119 exercise illustrations were supplied by the project owner using the project's pose prompts. The colour style study and workout sounds were created for this project. Reference screenshots are used for layout study and are not bundled.
credits.map: Muscle-map paths: © 2022 ELABBASSI Hicham, MIT. Lat and hip-flexor highlights use nearby shapes from the source artwork and are approximate.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body: Your profile, measurements, workout history, custom workouts, achievements and preferences are stored on your device. The app has no accounts, ads, analytics or app servers. It does not send your workout or health data to us.
privacy.backupBody: Export creates a file containing your saved app data. You choose its destination in your phone's share sheet. A destination app or cloud service handles that file under its own policies. Keep personal backups somewhere you trust.
privacy.reminderBody: Reminders use your phone's local notification system. Notification permission is requested only when you choose to enable them. You can turn them off in Settings.
privacy.deleteBody: Backup and data → Reset all data removes the app's saved profile, history and preferences and starts onboarding again. Files you already exported to other apps or folders are not removed.

disclaimer.title: Exercise disclaimer
disclaimer.body: This app provides general exercise information for adults aged 18 and over. It does not diagnose conditions or replace advice from a qualified health professional. Static illustrations show one position rather than the entire movement. Calorie totals and BMI are estimates, not medical assessments.

about.title: About
about.body: Free, offline workouts with exercise guides, custom plans, local progress and optional reminders. No accounts, ads or subscriptions.

march_in_place.name: March in Place
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and arms relaxed.
Lift one knee, lower it, then alternate knees while swinging the opposite arm.
Keep a pace that lets you change direction with control.
mistakes: Leaning backward as the knees rise.
Losing posture as the pace increases.
Moving so quickly that the steps or arm motions lose control.
breathing: Start with a relaxed breathing rhythm.
Breathe continuously as the pace increases.
Slow the pace if you cannot keep breathing comfortably.

arm_circles.name: Arm Circles
instructions: Stand tall and extend both arms out to the sides.
Draw small circles with the arms, then reverse direction.
Move only through a comfortable range, then return slowly to the start.
mistakes: Making the circles so large that the shoulders feel strained.
Moving so fast that the joints lose control.
Forcing the range instead of easing into it.
breathing: Begin with an easy breath in.
Breathe out during the moving part.
Breathe in as you return; do not hold your breath.

shoulder_rolls.name: Shoulder Rolls
instructions: Stand or sit tall with arms relaxed at your sides.
Lift the shoulders gently, roll them back and down, then change direction.
Move only through a comfortable range, then return slowly to the start.
mistakes: Lifting the shoulders forcefully toward the ears.
Moving so fast that the joints lose control.
Forcing the range instead of easing into it.
breathing: Begin with an easy breath in.
Breathe out during the moving part.
Breathe in as you return; do not hold your breath.

hip_circles.name: Hip Circles
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart and hands on the hips.
Circle the hips slowly in one direction, then reverse.
Move only through a comfortable range, then return slowly to the start.
mistakes: Twisting the knees sharply while the hips circle.
Moving so fast that the joints lose control.
Forcing the range instead of easing into it.
breathing: Begin with an easy breath in.
Breathe out during the moving part.
Breathe in as you return; do not hold your breath.

leg_swings_front.name: Leg Swings (Front)
instructions: Stand beside a stable wall and hold it lightly for balance.
Swing one leg forward and back in a small controlled arc, then switch legs.
Return to the start slowly and use stable support when needed.
mistakes: Swinging so high that the lower back arches.
Rushing while balance is unsteady.
Leaning on an unstable chair or wall fixture.
breathing: Breathe in before moving.
Breathe out during the effort.
Keep breathing normally while you steady yourself.

leg_swings_side.name: Leg Swings (Side)
instructions: Face a stable wall and hold it lightly with both hands.
Swing one leg across and out to the side without rotating the trunk, then switch.
Return to the start slowly and use stable support when needed.
mistakes: Turning the whole torso to make the swing larger.
Rushing while balance is unsteady.
Leaning on an unstable chair or wall fixture.
breathing: Breathe in before moving.
Breathe out during the effort.
Keep breathing normally while you steady yourself.

torso_twist.name: Torso Twist
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart and knees soft.
Rotate the upper body gently left and right while the hips mostly face forward.
Move only through a comfortable range, then return slowly to the start.
mistakes: Forcing the neck or lower back through a large twist.
Moving so fast that the joints lose control.
Forcing the range instead of easing into it.
breathing: Begin with an easy breath in.
Breathe out during the moving part.
Breathe in as you return; do not hold your breath.

neck_rolls.name: Neck Rolls
instructions: Stand or sit tall with shoulders relaxed.
Tilt the head gently to one side, move through a small front arc, then to the other side.
Move only through a comfortable range, then return slowly to the start.
mistakes: Dropping the head far backward or forcing a full circle.
Moving so fast that the joints lose control.
Forcing the range instead of easing into it.
breathing: Begin with an easy breath in.
Breathe out during the moving part.
Breathe in as you return; do not hold your breath.

cat_cow.name: Cat-Cow
instructions: Start on hands and knees with wrists under shoulders and knees under hips.
Round the back gently, then lengthen the spine and lift the chest slightly.
Move only through a comfortable range, then return slowly to the start.
mistakes: Throwing the head back or pushing into a painful arch.
Moving so fast that the joints lose control.
Forcing the range instead of easing into it.
breathing: Begin with an easy breath in.
Breathe out during the moving part.
Breathe in as you return; do not hold your breath.

inchworm_walkout.name: Inchworm Walkout
instructions: Stand tall, soften the knees and fold toward the floor.
Walk the hands forward to a strong plank, then walk them back and stand.
Return with control while keeping the trunk steady.
mistakes: Letting the hips sag when the hands reach plank.
Using momentum instead of the abdominal muscles.
Letting the lower back move farther than you can control.
breathing: Breathe in before each repetition.
Breathe out during the effort or reach.
Breathe in as you return with control.

crunch.name: Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet planted.
Lift the shoulder blades a short distance using the abdomen, then lower.
Return with control while keeping the trunk steady.
mistakes: Pulling the head forward with the hands.
Using momentum instead of the abdominal muscles.
Letting the lower back move farther than you can control.
breathing: Breathe in before each repetition.
Breathe out during the effort or reach.
Breathe in as you return with control.

reverse_crunch.name: Reverse Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent over the hips.
Curl the pelvis gently toward the ribs, lifting the hips slightly, then lower.
Return with control while keeping the trunk steady.
mistakes: Swinging the legs to gain momentum.
Using momentum instead of the abdominal muscles.
Letting the lower back move farther than you can control.
breathing: Breathe in before each repetition.
Breathe out during the effort or reach.
Breathe in as you return with control.

bicycle_crunch.name: Bicycle Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back with hands lightly beside the head and knees raised.
Rotate one shoulder toward the opposite knee while extending the other leg, then alternate.
Return with control while keeping the trunk steady.
mistakes: Yanking the neck with the hands.
Using momentum instead of the abdominal muscles.
Letting the lower back move farther than you can control.
breathing: Breathe in before each repetition.
Breathe out during the effort or reach.
Breathe in as you return with control.

sit_up.name: Sit-Up
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet on the floor.
Roll the trunk up toward the knees with control, then lower slowly.
Return with control while keeping the trunk steady.
mistakes: Jerking the body upward with momentum.
Using momentum instead of the abdominal muscles.
Letting the lower back move farther than you can control.
breathing: Breathe in before each repetition.
Breathe out during the effort or reach.
Breathe in as you return with control.

leg_raise.name: Leg Raise
instructions: Lie on your back with legs long and hands by your sides.
Raise the legs together only as far as you can keep the lower back controlled, then lower.
Return with control while keeping the trunk steady.
mistakes: Lowering the legs until the lower back lifts sharply from the floor.
Using momentum instead of the abdominal muscles.
Letting the lower back move farther than you can control.
breathing: Breathe in before each repetition.
Breathe out during the effort or reach.
Breathe in as you return with control.

flutter_kick.name: Flutter Kick
instructions: Lie on your back with legs extended and the lower back comfortable.
Lift the legs slightly and alternate small up-and-down kicks.
Return with control while keeping the trunk steady.
mistakes: Making large kicks that pull the lower back off the floor.
Using momentum instead of the abdominal muscles.
Letting the lower back move farther than you can control.
breathing: Breathe in before each repetition.
Breathe out during the effort or reach.
Breathe in as you return with control.

scissor_kick.name: Scissor Kick
instructions: Lie on your back with long legs lifted slightly.
Cross one leg over the other in small alternating motions.
Return with control while keeping the trunk steady.
mistakes: Swinging the legs so far that the pelvis rocks.
Using momentum instead of the abdominal muscles.
Letting the lower back move farther than you can control.
breathing: Breathe in before each repetition.
Breathe out during the effort or reach.
Breathe in as you return with control.

heel_touch.name: Heel Touch
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet close enough to reach toward.
Lift the shoulders slightly and reach side to side toward each heel.
Return with control while keeping the trunk steady.
mistakes: Pulling on the neck or swinging the trunk.
Using momentum instead of the abdominal muscles.
Letting the lower back move farther than you can control.
breathing: Breathe in before each repetition.
Breathe out during the effort or reach.
Breathe in as you return with control.

russian_twist.name: Russian Twist
instructions: Sit with knees bent, feet supported and chest lifted.
Rotate the ribs gently from side to side while keeping the spine long.
Return with control while keeping the trunk steady.
mistakes: Rounding the back and throwing the arms across the body.
Using momentum instead of the abdominal muscles.
Letting the lower back move farther than you can control.
breathing: Breathe in before each repetition.
Breathe out during the effort or reach.
Breathe in as you return with control.

forearm_plank.name: Forearm Plank
instructions: Place forearms on the floor with elbows under the shoulders.
Step the feet back and lift into a straight line from head to heels.
Hold a steady line for the target time, then lower gently.
mistakes: Letting the lower back sag while the elbows drift ahead.
Letting the hips sag or rise well above the shoulders.
Tensing the neck or shrugging the shoulders.
breathing: Take a calm breath before lifting.
Keep breathing steadily during the hold.
Avoid holding your breath as you brace.

side_plank_each_side.name: Side Plank (each side)
instructions: Lie on one side with the supporting elbow under the shoulder.
Lift the hips until the body forms a long line; repeat on the other side.
Hold a steady line for the target time, then lower gently.
mistakes: Allowing the supporting shoulder to collapse toward the ear.
Letting the hips sag or rise well above the shoulders.
Tensing the neck or shrugging the shoulders.
breathing: Take a calm breath before lifting.
Keep breathing steadily during the hold.
Avoid holding your breath as you brace.

plank_shoulder_tap.name: Plank Shoulder Tap
instructions: Start in a high plank with hands under shoulders and feet a little apart.
Tap one shoulder with the opposite hand, replace it, then alternate.
Return to a steady plank before the next repetition.
mistakes: Rocking the hips widely from side to side.
Letting the hips sag as the arms move.
Turning the pelvis instead of keeping the trunk steady.
breathing: Breathe in as you set the plank.
Breathe out during the arm movement.
Breathe in as you reset without holding your breath.

dead_bug.name: Dead Bug
instructions: Lie on your back with hips and knees bent and arms reaching up.
Lower one arm and the opposite leg slowly, return, then alternate sides.
Return with control while keeping the trunk steady.
mistakes: Arching the lower back as the leg extends.
Using momentum instead of the abdominal muscles.
Letting the lower back move farther than you can control.
breathing: Breathe in before each repetition.
Breathe out during the effort or reach.
Breathe in as you return with control.

hollow_hold.name: Hollow Hold
instructions: Lie on your back and gently draw the ribs toward the pelvis.
Lift the shoulders and legs only as far as the lower back stays controlled.
Hold only while the lower back stays comfortable, then release slowly.
mistakes: Reaching the legs too low and losing lower-back control.
Reaching the head forward instead of keeping the neck relaxed.
Tensing the neck or holding the breath.
breathing: Take a calm breath before lifting.
Keep breathing through the hold.
Release and rest if you cannot breathe comfortably.

mountain_climber.name: Mountain Climber
instructions: Begin in a high plank with hands below the shoulders.
Drive one knee toward the chest, replace it, then alternate at a steady pace.
Keep a pace that lets you change direction with control.
mistakes: Bouncing the hips high as the feet switch.
Losing posture as the pace increases.
Moving so quickly that the steps or arm motions lose control.
breathing: Start with a relaxed breathing rhythm.
Breathe continuously as the pace increases.
Slow the pace if you cannot keep breathing comfortably.

v_up.name: V-Up
instructions: Lie long on your back with arms overhead and legs together.
Lift arms and legs toward each other, then lower with control.
Return with control while keeping the trunk steady.
mistakes: Throwing the arms forward to yank the trunk up.
Using momentum instead of the abdominal muscles.
Letting the lower back move farther than you can control.
breathing: Breathe in before each repetition.
Breathe out during the effort or reach.
Breathe in as you return with control.

toe_touch_crunch.name: Toe Touch Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back with legs reaching toward the ceiling.
Lift the shoulder blades and reach toward the toes, then lower.
Return with control while keeping the trunk steady.
mistakes: Pulling the head forward to reach higher.
Using momentum instead of the abdominal muscles.
Letting the lower back move farther than you can control.
breathing: Breathe in before each repetition.
Breathe out during the effort or reach.
Breathe in as you return with control.

cross_touch_and_reach.name: Cross Touch and Reach
instructions: Stand tall with feet wider than hips and arms out.
Hinge and reach one hand toward the opposite foot, then rise and reach upward; alternate.
Move only through a comfortable range, then return slowly to the start.
mistakes: Twisting the knees or forcing the hand all the way to the foot.
Moving so fast that the joints lose control.
Forcing the range instead of easing into it.
breathing: Begin with an easy breath in.
Breathe out during the moving part.
Breathe in as you return; do not hold your breath.

standing_oblique_crunch.name: Standing Oblique Crunch
instructions: Stand tall with hands lightly beside the head.
Lift one knee toward the same-side elbow by shortening the side of the trunk, then alternate.
Return with control while keeping the trunk steady.
mistakes: Pulling the head downward to meet the knee.
Using momentum instead of the abdominal muscles.
Letting the lower back move farther than you can control.
breathing: Breathe in before each repetition.
Breathe out during the effort or reach.
Breathe in as you return with control.

wall_push_up.name: Wall Push-Up
instructions: Face a stable wall with hands at chest height and feet stepped back.
Bend the elbows to bring the chest toward the wall while the body stays straight.
Press back to the start at a pace you can control.
mistakes: Letting the head reach the wall before the chest.
Letting the hips sag instead of moving as one unit.
Flaring the elbows excessively or shrugging the shoulders.
breathing: Breathe in as you lower.
Breathe out as you press away.
Keep breathing between repetitions.

incline_push_up.name: Incline Push-Up
instructions: Place hands on a stable, non-slip chair or surface and walk the feet back.
Lower the chest toward the support by bending the elbows.
Press back to the start at a pace you can control.
mistakes: Using a chair that can slide or tip.
Letting the hips sag instead of moving as one unit.
Flaring the elbows excessively or shrugging the shoulders.
breathing: Breathe in as you lower.
Breathe out as you press away.
Keep breathing between repetitions.

knee_push_up.name: Knee Push-Up
instructions: Set hands below the shoulders and keep knees on a padded floor.
Lower the chest while the trunk stays aligned from head to knees.
Press back to the start at a pace you can control.
mistakes: Bending at the hips instead of lowering the whole trunk.
Letting the hips sag instead of moving as one unit.
Flaring the elbows excessively or shrugging the shoulders.
breathing: Breathe in as you lower.
Breathe out as you press away.
Keep breathing between repetitions.

standard_push_up.name: Standard Push-Up
instructions: Start in a high plank with hands just wider than the shoulders.
Bend the elbows and lower the chest while keeping a long body line.
Press back to the start at a pace you can control.
mistakes: Letting the chin lead while the chest stays high.
Letting the hips sag instead of moving as one unit.
Flaring the elbows excessively or shrugging the shoulders.
breathing: Breathe in as you lower.
Breathe out as you press away.
Keep breathing between repetitions.

wide_push_up.name: Wide Push-Up
instructions: Place hands wider than shoulder width in a firm high plank.
Lower the chest between the hands with elbows moving comfortably outward.
Press back to the start at a pace you can control.
mistakes: Placing the hands so wide that the shoulders lose control.
Letting the hips sag instead of moving as one unit.
Flaring the elbows excessively or shrugging the shoulders.
breathing: Breathe in as you lower.
Breathe out as you press away.
Keep breathing between repetitions.

diamond_push_up.name: Diamond Push-Up
instructions: Place hands close together under the chest in a strong high plank.
Bend the elbows close to the body and lower only as far as control allows.
Press back to the start at a pace you can control.
mistakes: Forcing the wrists into an uncomfortable angle.
Letting the hips sag instead of moving as one unit.
Flaring the elbows excessively or shrugging the shoulders.
breathing: Breathe in as you lower.
Breathe out as you press away.
Keep breathing between repetitions.

decline_push_up.name: Decline Push-Up
instructions: Place feet on a stable, non-slip low support and hands on the floor.
Keep a firm plank while lowering the chest toward the floor.
Press back to the start at a pace you can control.
mistakes: Using a support that moves or lifting the hips high.
Letting the hips sag instead of moving as one unit.
Flaring the elbows excessively or shrugging the shoulders.
breathing: Breathe in as you lower.
Breathe out as you press away.
Keep breathing between repetitions.

archer_push_up.name: Archer Push-Up

Bend one arm while the other stays longer, shift toward the bending side, then alternate.
Press back to the start at a pace you can control.
mistakes: Dropping suddenly onto the working shoulder.
Letting the hips sag instead of moving as one unit.
Flaring the elbows excessively or shrugging the shoulders.
breathing: Breathe in as you lower.
Breathe out as you press away.
Keep breathing between repetitions.

push_up_hold.name: Push-Up Hold
instructions: Set up in a high plank with hands beneath the shoulders.
Bend the elbows slightly and hold the body rigid at a comfortable depth.
Hold a steady line for the target time, then lower gently.
mistakes: Lowering so far that the shoulders or wrists lose control.
Letting the hips sag or rise well above the shoulders.
Tensing the neck or shrugging the shoulders.
breathing: Take a calm breath before lifting.
Keep breathing steadily during the hold.
Avoid holding your breath as you brace.

plank_to_push_up.name: Plank to Push-Up
instructions: Begin on the forearms in a firm plank.
Place one hand down, then the other to rise into high plank; lower one forearm at a time.
Return to a steady plank before the next repetition.
mistakes: Swinging the hips widely as the arms change level.
Letting the hips sag as the arms move.
Turning the pelvis instead of keeping the trunk steady.
breathing: Breathe in as you set the plank.
Breathe out during the arm movement.
Breathe in as you reset without holding your breath.

chest_squeeze_isometric.name: Chest Squeeze (isometric)
instructions: Stand or sit tall with palms pressed together in front of the chest.
Press the palms together gently and hold without lifting the shoulders.
Hold gentle tension for the target time, then release gradually.
mistakes: Pressing so hard that the wrists bend or the neck tenses.
Tensing the neck and shoulders unnecessarily.
Forcing the joints into an uncomfortable position.
breathing: Take a calm breath before the hold.
Breathe steadily while applying tension.
Do not hold your breath during the effort.

shoulder_tap_push_up.name: Shoulder Tap Push-Up
instructions: Begin in a high plank with feet apart for balance.
Complete one controlled push-up, then tap each opposite shoulder without twisting the hips.

Breathe out during the jump or step.
Keep breathing normally as you land and reset.

fast_feet.name: Fast Feet
instructions: Stand in a shallow athletic stance with feet under the hips.
Take quick, short steps in place while keeping the upper body steady.
Keep a pace that lets you change direction with control.
mistakes: Taking steps so wide that the feet tangle.
Losing posture as the pace increases.
Moving so quickly that the steps or arm motions lose control.
breathing: Start with a relaxed breathing rhythm.
Breathe continuously as the pace increases.
Slow the pace if you cannot keep breathing comfortably.

shadow_boxing.name: Shadow Boxing
instructions: Stand in a staggered stance with soft knees and hands by the face.
Throw light alternating punches into open space, returning each hand to guard.
Keep a pace that lets you change direction with control.
mistakes: Locking the elbow hard at the end of a punch.
Losing posture as the pace increases.
Moving so quickly that the steps or arm motions lose control.
breathing: Start with a relaxed breathing rhythm.
Breathe continuously as the pace increases.
Slow the pace if you cannot keep breathing comfortably.

standing_knee_to_elbow.name: Standing Knee to Elbow
instructions: Stand tall with elbows bent and feet hip-width apart.
Lift one knee toward the opposite elbow, lower it, then alternate sides.
Keep a pace that lets you change direction with control.
mistakes: Pulling the head down sharply to meet the knee.
Losing posture as the pace increases.
Moving so quickly that the steps or arm motions lose control.
breathing: Start with a relaxed breathing rhythm.
Breathe continuously as the pace increases.
Slow the pace if you cannot keep breathing comfortably.

childs_pose.name: Child's Pose
instructions: Kneel on a comfortable surface with knees apart as needed.
Sit the hips gently toward the heels and reach the arms forward.
Hold a gentle stretch without bouncing, then ease out slowly.
mistakes: Forcing the hips onto the heels when the knees feel uncomfortable.
Pulling into a painful range.
Bouncing or forcing the stretch.
breathing: Breathe in as you find the position.
Breathe out as you soften into the stretch.
Keep taking slow, comfortable breaths during the hold.

cobra_stretch.name: Cobra Stretch
instructions: Lie face down with hands near the ribs and legs long.
Press lightly through the hands to lift the chest only as far as the lower back feels comfortable.
Hold a gentle stretch without bouncing, then ease out slowly.
mistakes: Locking the elbows and forcing a deep backbend.
Pulling into a painful range.
Bouncing or forcing the stretch.
breathing: Breathe in as you find the position.
Breathe out as you soften into the stretch.
Keep taking slow, comfortable breaths during the hold.

downward_dog.name: Downward Dog
instructions: Start on hands and knees with hands shoulder-width apart.
Lift the hips up and back, keeping the knees soft if the legs feel tight.
Hold a gentle stretch without bouncing, then ease out slowly.
mistakes: Forcing the heels flat by rounding the back.
Pulling into a painful range.
Bouncing or forcing the stretch.
breathing: Breathe in as you find the position.
Breathe out as you soften into the stretch.
Keep taking slow, comfortable breaths during the hold.

seated_forward_fold.name: Seated Forward Fold
instructions: Sit tall with legs forward and knees slightly bent if needed.
Hinge from the hips and reach toward the legs without pulling the spine into a deep curve.
Hold a gentle stretch without bouncing, then ease out slowly.
mistakes: Yanking on the feet to force a deeper fold.
Pulling into a painful range.
Bouncing or forcing the stretch.
breathing: Breathe in as you find the position.
Breathe out as you soften into the stretch.
Keep taking slow, comfortable breaths during the hold.

standing_forward_fold.name: Standing Forward Fold
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart and knees soft.
Hinge at the hips and let the torso fold forward only as far as comfortable.
Hold a gentle stretch without bouncing, then ease out slowly.
mistakes: Locking the knees and pulling the body downward.
Pulling into a painful range.
Bouncing or forcing the stretch.
breathing: Breathe in as you find the position.
Breathe out as you soften into the stretch.
Keep taking slow, comfortable breaths during the hold.

hamstring_stretch_each_leg.name: Hamstring Stretch (each leg)
instructions: Place one heel ahead with the knee softly bent and toes up.
Hinge at the hips until a gentle stretch is felt behind that thigh, then switch legs.
Hold a gentle stretch without bouncing, then ease out slowly.
mistakes: Rounding the back to reach the toes.
Pulling into a painful range.
Bouncing or forcing the stretch.
breathing: Breathe in as you find the position.
Breathe out as you soften into the stretch.
Keep taking slow, comfortable breaths during the hold.

quad_stretch_each_leg.name: Quad Stretch (each leg)
instructions: Stand beside a stable wall and hold it lightly for balance.
Bend one knee and bring the heel toward the glute, holding the foot only if comfortable.
Hold a gentle stretch without bouncing, then ease out slowly.
mistakes: Pulling the foot sharply or arching the lower back.
Pulling into a painful range.
Bouncing or forcing the stretch.
breathing: Breathe in as you find the position.
Breathe out as you soften into the stretch.
Keep taking slow, comfortable breaths during the hold.

hip_flexor_stretch_each_side.name: Hip Flexor Stretch (each side)
instructions: Kneel in a split stance on a soft surface with the front foot planted.
Gently shift the hips forward while keeping the trunk tall, then change sides.
Hold a gentle stretch without bouncing, then ease out slowly.
mistakes: Arching the lower back to create a larger stretch.
Pulling into a painful range.
Bouncing or forcing the stretch.
breathing: Breathe in as you find the position.
Breathe out as you soften into the stretch.
Keep taking slow, comfortable breaths during the hold.

figure_4_glute_stretch.name: Figure-4 Glute Stretch
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and place one ankle over the opposite thigh.
Draw the supporting leg gently toward the chest, then change sides.
Hold a gentle stretch without bouncing, then ease out slowly.
mistakes: Pressing directly on the raised knee.
Pulling into a painful range.
Bouncing or forcing the stretch.
breathing: Breathe in as you find the position.
Breathe out as you soften into the stretch.
Keep taking slow, comfortable breaths during the hold.

butterfly_stretch.name: Butterfly Stretch
instructions: Sit tall with the soles of the feet together.
Let the knees relax outward and hinge forward a little if comfortable.
Hold a gentle stretch without bouncing, then ease out slowly.
mistakes: Pushing the knees down with the hands.
Pulling into a painful range.
Bouncing or forcing the stretch.
breathing: Breathe in as you find the position.
Breathe out as you soften into the stretch.
Keep taking slow, comfortable breaths during the hold.

chest_doorway_stretch.name: Chest Doorway Stretch
instructions: Stand in a stable doorway and place forearms on the frame at a comfortable height.
Step gently forward until a light stretch is felt across the chest.
Hold a gentle stretch without bouncing, then ease out slowly.
mistakes: Pushing through shoulder pain or placing arms too high.
Pulling into a painful range.
Bouncing or forcing the stretch.
breathing: Breathe in as you find the position.
Breathe out as you soften into the stretch.
Keep taking slow, comfortable breaths during the hold.

triceps_stretch.name: Triceps Stretch
instructions: Stand or sit tall and lift one arm overhead.
Bend that elbow and use the other hand for a light assist, then change arms.
Hold a gentle stretch without bouncing, then ease out slowly.
mistakes: Pulling the elbow sharply behind the head.
Pulling into a painful range.
Bouncing or forcing the stretch.
breathing: Breathe in as you find the position.
Breathe out as you soften into the stretch.
Keep taking slow, comfortable breaths during the hold.

neck_side_stretch.name: Neck Side Stretch
instructions: Sit or stand tall with both shoulders relaxed.
Tilt one ear gently toward the same-side shoulder, then switch sides.
Hold a gentle stretch without bouncing, then ease out slowly.
mistakes: Pulling the head down with the hand.
Pulling into a painful range.
Bouncing or forcing the stretch.
breathing: Breathe in as you find the position.
Breathe out as you soften into the stretch.
Keep taking slow, comfortable breaths during the hold.

thoracic_rotation.name: Thoracic Rotation
instructions: Start on hands and knees or in a comfortable side-lying position.
Rotate the upper back to open one arm toward the ceiling, then return and change sides.
Move only through a comfortable range, then return slowly to the start.
mistakes: Twisting the lower back to gain extra range.
Moving so fast that the joints lose control.
Forcing the range instead of easing into it.
breathing: Begin with an easy breath in.
Breathe out during the moving part.
Breathe in as you return; do not hold your breath.

knee_to_chest.name: Knee to Chest
instructions: Lie on your back with both legs comfortable.
Bring one knee gently toward the chest while the other leg stays relaxed, then switch.
Hold a gentle stretch without bouncing, then ease out slowly.
mistakes: Yanking the knee toward the chest.
Pulling into a painful range.
Bouncing or forcing the stretch.
breathing: Breathe in as you find the position.
Breathe out as you soften into the stretch.
Keep taking slow, comfortable breaths during the hold.

lying_spinal_twist.name: Lying Spinal Twist
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and arms open.
Let both knees move gently to one side while the shoulders stay comfortable, then switch.
Hold a gentle stretch without bouncing, then ease out slowly.
mistakes: Forcing the knees to the floor while the shoulder lifts painfully.
Pulling into a painful range.
Bouncing or forcing the stretch.
breathing: Breathe in as you find the position.
Breathe out as you soften into the stretch.
Keep taking slow, comfortable breaths during the hold.
